messages:
rachel: Quick pitch: run a 'pricing signpost' experiment that surfaces a one-paragraph benchmark + a tiny cost snapshot next to each tier. Purpose: reduce pricing bounce and give buyers a quick mental model. Launch behind flag `pricing_signpost_v1` next Thu 09:00 PT.

diego: Love the signpost idea. Two arms: A = benchmark paragraph + micro-snapshot, B = snapshot only. Hypothesis: paragraph increases trust and demo requests, snapshot alone increases quick conversions.

sunita: Copy plan: short benchmark (3 bullets) showing typical token ranges for chat/summarize/embed for a 5-dev team. One-line callouts per tier: who it's for and an example use-case. Will hand over drafts by Tue noon.

otto: Dev notes: micro-snapshot will call `/api/estimate-v1` with `seats` and `workload_profile`. Posting leads uses `/api/inbound-lead`. Feature flag `pricing_signpost_v1`. Events: `signpost:view`, `signpost:estimate`, `signpost:lead`. Keep payload small (variant_id, seats, est_arr).

rachel: Routing rules: if est_arr >= 30k -> sales-inbound; if user clicks "Request demo" -> AE ping. Otherwise, funnel to nurture flow. Add `lead_source=pricing_signpost` in payload.

diego: Metrics: primary = demo requests / page view; secondary = trial starts and support threads labeled `pricing`. Baseline demo rate = 0.7%. Aim +0.25pp. Also track time-on-page for signpost viewers.

sunita: UX detail: show signpost inline under the first hero paragraph, make dismissible. Keep snapshot UI to a single line: "~$X/mo for 5 devs (monthly)" with a small expand for inputs.

infra-bot: Preview deployed: https://preview.redwood/pricing-signpost-4976543210 (flag: pricing_signpost_v1). A/B toggles enabled.

otto: ETA: 2 dev days for snapshot + routing. If we want the expand input in v1 it adds 1 day. Recommend soft-launch without expand.

rachel: OK let's soft-launch Thu 09:00 PT at 20% traffic. Run 12 days. Daily morning snapshot to #marketing-daily. Quick retro after 12 days. Thanks all :sparkles:
